purpose: WP0 evidence freeze for the COSE-D-26-04000 substantive revision.

provenance_findings.finding: Historical results in results/ were written 2026-06-06 02:01 to 2026-06-07 22:07 (LightGBM exploration 2026-07-04). The V2 source code was first committed at 2026-06-07 22:45 (75538db).
provenance_findings.consequence: The exact code state that produced each result is not version-controlled. Commit 75538db is the closest recoverable state; equivalence must be established by rerunning (see scripts/revision/wp0_rerun_committed_pipeline.sh and wp0_compare_reproduction.py; result in P7).

provenance_findings.finding: results/ and data/ are git-ignored and stored in an iCloud-synchronised folder; several result and raw files are evicted (dataless) until read.
provenance_findings.consequence: Historical outputs have no version history. The WP0 archive is the preserved copy.

provenance_findings.finding: results/nf_uq_nids_v2/robustness_lightgbm_temp and robustness_lightgbm_unweighted_temp were produced with model names 'lightgbm' and 'lightgbm_unweighted', which scripts/run_nf_uq_robustness.py does not accept.
provenance_findings.consequence: The LightGBM exploration used uncommitted code. Its outputs are inventoried as exploratory; the exact code is unrecoverable.

provenance_findings.finding: Commits after the result runs changed only scripts/generate_manuscript_artifacts.py (table/figure formatting) and one description string in scripts/run_ait_stress_tests.py.
provenance_findings.consequence: No committed change after 75538db alters experiment logic.

provenance_findings.finding: The Computers & Security source in computers_security_elsevier_submission/ (cas-sc class, ids.tex modified 2026-07-10 12:25) differs from the last commit (elsarticle class). Reviewer references (weighted sum on page 9; native detector in Tables 6 and 7) match the uncommitted cas-sc version.
provenance_findings.consequence: The working-tree ids.tex/ids.pdf are treated as the submitted version. Confirm against the Editorial Manager PDF if available.

provenance_findings.finding: All seven figure files in the submission folder are byte-identical to v2_soc_alert_prioritization/manuscript/figures; tables in ids.tex were transcribed by hand from manuscript/generated_tables.
provenance_findings.consequence: Figure lineage is exact. Table values are verified numerically by wp0_recompute_claims.py.

provenance_findings.finding: Rerun of the committed code (2026-09-14) regenerates results/ait_alert/ranking_eval_asset_ambiguity (all 18 CSV files) and results/ait_alert/ranking_eval_full (all 17 mapping/reliability CSVs; ranking_metrics.csv identical in all 49 historical columns) cell for cell. The committed run_ait_ranking.py additionally writes context_mode/uncertainty_mode columns and three effort keys in the summary JSON, which the historical files lack.
provenance_findings.consequence: Experiment logic of the headline runs is reproduced by the committed code. The context/uncertainty options and summary keys were added to the script after ranking_eval_full was written and before commit, consistent with the selection history in claim_evidence_audit.md Section 4.3.
